allow: PowerShell(Write-Output "PWD: $\(Get-Location\)"; Write-Output "Item count: $\(\(Get-ChildItem -Force | Measure-Object\).Count\)"; python --version; Write-Output "---"; Get-Command libreoffice,soffice -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source)

PowerShell(python -c "import importlib.util as u; mods=['pydantic','bs4','lxml','pytest','streamlit','fitz','PIL','wordfreq','spellchecker','langdetect','jiwer','pandas']; [print\(m, 'OK' if u.find_spec\(m\) else 'MISSING'\) for m in mods]")
PowerShell(python -m pip install --quiet wordfreq pyspellchecker langdetect jiwer 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15; Write-Output "PIP_DONE exit=$LASTEXITCODE")

PowerShell($ok=$false; for\($i=0;$i -lt 25;$i++\){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8777/healthz" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; if\($r.StatusCode -eq 200\){ Write-Output "UP"; $ok=$true; break } } catch {} ; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 800 }; if\(-not $ok\){ Write-Output "not up" })
